derived: BIIB generated $6,043mm of free cash flow on $29,402mm of revenue over 2023, 2024 and 2025, a 20.55% margin, against the 28.0% its filed expense lines leave. Restated before interest: BIIB paid $762mm of interest inside operating cash flow over 2023 to 2025, 2.59% of revenue. The free cash flow above is struck after it and the valuation already charges the debt by subtracting net debt, so the charge falls by that much, from 8.78% to 6.19%. Restated at replacement capex: BIIB spent $584mm on plant over 2023 to 2025 against $814mm of plant depreciation, 0.78% of revenue below what keeps the plant running. Taken at depreciation, the charge rises from 6.19% to 7.11%. Restated without one-off cash: BIIB's free cash flow over 2023 to 2025 carried $444mm of deal payments in operating cash flow, capital allocation whose assets the book values separately; $234mm of US transition tax (2025 instalment 234mm). None recurs, so the charge falls from 7.11% to 4.66%. Restated without working capital build: over 2023 to 2025 BIIB's cash flow statement shows receivables down $386mm, inventories up $469mm, payables and accrued liabilities down $6mm, a working capital build of $89mm, 0.30% of revenue. Growth ties that cash up once, not on every product for ever, so the charge falls from 4.66% to 4.30%.
